stall_review.clean_power_off_criterion: New measured straight clean power-off stall with defensible corrected airspeed, run loading, event criterion and uncertainty for the matched aircraft. Handbook nominal conditions and raw IAS are retained as source references.

variants.open: The 89.4 kt CAS clean power-off row was already available. A run sheet would identify the airframe, actual loading, altitude and test settings for the summary values.

sources.qualification: NATC normal-fighter table. The report lists three serials and leaves the stall-run serial unspecified.

conditions.weight_basis: normal fighter loading in the report

variants.open: Eng-47-1749-A §V.E gives nine 67.5–86 mph IAS stalls at 8,000 ft with instantaneous weights. The gear/flaps-up Figure 1 has an axis beginning at 100 mph and its first measured calibration point near 150 mph. Recover a low-speed position-error run or independent position-corrected stall on the same installation.

sources.qualification: Gear and flaps up with cooling shutters closed. Figure 1 has no calibration at this speed.
Gear and flaps up with cooling shutters open. Figure 1 has no calibration at this speed.

variants.open: The clean Fig. 5, powered climb Fig. 7 and landing Fig. 9 add active-control runs to the existing fixed-control figures. Seek the recorder reduction or low-speed calibration and the per-run fuel/loading log. The 11,200 lb value is approximate takeoff weight.

sources.qualification: First roll-off reading window. Part III leaves the reduction applied to the indicated channel unconfirmed. Loading is the approximate takeoff weight.

variants.open: New operating points are for the Mk IX handbook family. Recover a full-span Merlin 66 flight trial with mass at the stall and low-speed calibration for BS.543 or an identified comparable airframe.

sources.qualification: Family pilot notes include the LF Mk IX. The table leaves test serial and wingtip configuration unspecified.

variants.open: The preliminary handbook identifies normal load only. The 41-5902 clean test gives 105 mph IAS, below its available clean calibration. Seek a calibration and run loading that match that installation.

sources.qualification: Original 41-5902 trial. The 12,565 lb figure is the test summary loading. The run weight and stall-range calibration are unresolved.

variants.open: 42-12690 supplies five measured stall points at approximately 14,800 lb and 10,000 ft. The clean power-off point is usable as a calibrated source comparison for this G-1-LO. Power-on CAS is printed below the respective tables' IAS ranges. The clean test on 42-12687 and the 42-12690 run-by-run load and break criterion remain open.

sources.qualification: Sister airframe 42-12690 with its own pitot installation. The gross weight and altitude are approximate.
D through G handbook row at 15,000 lb. Power is unreported.

variants.open: WNr 210002 Eltron installation correction spans 360–550 km/h. Seek a WNr 210002 stall test with configuration and weight, and a low-speed calibration for that installation. Wright Field FE-120/WNr 601088 would be a separate case.

calculation.qualification: Uses the documented combat-climb starting mass as a reference loading for a clean, power-off estimate. The available Eltron correction starts at 360 km/h.

variants.open: WNr 783 Nr. 1/2/4 describe speed, climb and cooling. Seek the WNr 783 low-speed test or a named A-4 handling report. A-3 WNr 313 and US EB-104 are separate variants. The WNr 2310 number is landing speed.

calculation.wing_area_source: Project-supplied Google AI ww2_fighters_dataset(1).json, Fw 190 A-5 and A-8 airframe.wing_area_m2, transferred
calculation.cl_max_source: Project-supplied Google AI ww2_fighters_dataset(1).json, Fw 190 A-5 and A-8 airframe.cl_max_clean, transferred as an engineering assumption
calculation.qualification: Uses WNr 783 test loading and same-family geometry and lift assumptions. Brown's 127 mph A-4/U8 recollection leaves the speed basis, run loading and power unspecified.

variants.open: T.O. 01-25CH-1 §II gives 92 mph clean and 82 mph landing IAS for the P-40F/L family. The separately stated 8,500 lb normal gross weight is an operating limit reference. Recover the actual stall-test power, load and in-range position correction for 41-13635.

sources.qualification: P-40F/L pilot manual, approximate operating value. The handbook leaves stall-run mass, power and instrument correction unspecified.

variants.open: T-2 302 Interim Report No. 3 already gives 102/90/79 mph IAS. Its 7,900 lb value is takeoff weight. Recover the run load and airspeed calibration. The PACMIRS metric table has a separate lineage and ambiguous power column.

sources.qualification: T-2 aircraft 302. The report gives takeoff weight. The weight at the stall and airspeed calibration are unresolved.

variants.open: Fig. 59 adds an accelerated landing stall. The clean near-1g windows in Figs. 49, 50 and 51a already exist. TN 2899 Fig. 34 retains the service-indicated label. Verify that the RM trace was reduced with the TN 2675 low-speed calibration or recover the numerical correction.

sources.qualification: Clean-glide roll and acceleration break, Figure 49. The chart labels the channel service indicated. The range is a chart reading window.

variants.open: The flight and calculation sheets give 135 km/h landing speed at 2,560 and 2,570 kg respectively. Seek the separate clean stall in a Rechlin or factory report with airspeed reduction and test loading.

calculation.cl_max_source: Project-supplied Google AI ww2_fighters_dataset(1).json, bf109_f4 airframe.cl_max_clean, used as an engineering assumption
calculation.qualification: Uses loading and wing area from the 29 November 1941 Messerschmitt sheet. Its separate 135 km/h figure describes landing.

variants.open: NII VVS p. 43 Table 2 already records 180/170/165 km/h indicated and 186/176/171 km/h in the source Vᵢ column. The method descends to loss of control. Recover the Vᵢ correction definition, gear and engine state for the glide and actual stall weight. Keep gun-pod WNr 14513 separate from MT-215.

sources.qualification: Captured G-2/Trop handling trial. Use with its own installation. Stall-run mass, power and near-stall correction are unspecified.
